meta.period: Residential through June 2026; rates as of July 23, 2026
meta.coverage: SE Florida (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Martin, St. Lucie) + statewide FL
meta.disclaimer: Figures compiled from public market reports (Florida Realtors, MIAMI Realtors, CBRE, Freddie Mac, FL OIR) and are informational only - not investment, tax, or financial advice. Deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
meta.note_source: Residential county metrics pulled monthly from the Florida Realtors county market reports (floridarealtors.org/tools-research/reports/florida-market-reports), released ~the 17th of each month for the prior month. This replaced the RAPB-GFLR ShowingTime MMI as the residential source on 2026-07-23 (ShowingTime lags; Florida Realtors publishes reliably mid-month and covers Miami-Dade).

residential.source: Florida Realtors Monthly Market Summary, June 2026 (data released July 17, 2026; compiled from FL MLS feeds on the 10th of the following month). Next release August 17, 2026.
residential.note: SF Median = single-family median sale price; Condo Median = townhouse/condo median sale price. Closed Sales YoY and Homes for Sale YoY are single-family, year-over-year.

luxury.headline: South Florida $1M+ sales +22% in Q1 2026; 361 sales above $10M in 2025 (highest since 2021)

highlights: Fort Lauderdale ranked #1 U.S. market for multifamily investment profitability (through late 2025).
Net absorption outpacing new deliveries in Broward and Palm Beach.
West Palm Beach office pipeline ~3.3M SF (~700K SF under construction).
